1.reason: record defect: the reviewer ran ruff check (all checks passed) and ruff format --check (already formatted) at head; only the log was unrecorded

findings.text: follow-on: the assertion that the whole reports root is not bound writable is vacuous — the argv is composed with writable=[stores.own_report] only, and fence_argv grants only roots it is handed, so the reports root is never among them and the assertion cannot redden; the skip it purports to guard (key in store_seal_keys at reckon/_worker_fence.py:1300) is the line that keeps production from re-opening the whole store, since delivery_write_roots hands reports_dir() and review_store_root() as writable roots into fence_argv at reckon/_backends.py:2214, and removing that skip leaves the suite green while the store is re-opened; the same holds at tests/test_a_worker_cannot_remove_another_runs_reports.py:236 for the review store.

follow-on: the done_when requires ruff check and ruff format --check to add no findings on the changed Python files against base, but the manifest records no ruff run and names no ruff log; I ran both at head (ruff check: All checks passed; ruff format --check: 2 files already formatted), so the clause holds but is unevidenced in the record.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 52c1c1f0; two commits, net +361/-1 spanning reckon/_worker_fence.py and the new test file, both inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_worker_cannot_remove_*_reports.py with a fenced rm refusal, two negative controls and a head-vs-base subset suite; the manifest records new-test.log (5 passed) and stores-negative-control.log (both arms fail).
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to seal the reports root and the review store read-only and re-bind only the run's declared paths under them writable; the diff adds shared_store_seal_roots at reckon/_worker_fence.py:1143 and seals both in fence_argv at reckon/_worker_fence.py:1273.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records commits 7853529ad and 2aa8df942, the subset suite 101 vs base 96, the store negative-control log, and both baseline_suite/after_suite with failure_count 0.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths include reckon/_worker_fence.py and the test file; the net diff touches only those two, and commit 1's reckon/_backends.py edit was reverted in commit 2, so nothing out of scope remains.

justifications.durability: the seal is guarded — tests/test_a_worker_cannot_remove_another_runs_reports.py:201 fails without the overlay and the executed refusal fails under the negative control — but the load-bearing skip at reckon/_worker_fence.py:1300 has no test, since no test hands a store root in as a writable root.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_worker_cannot_remove_another_runs_reports.py passes 5 and stores-negative-control.log fails one arm per store, but the done_when's ruff clause is unrecorded in manifest.md:10 and the whole-store-not-bound assertions at tests/test_a_worker_cannot_remove_another_runs_reports.py:212 are vacuous.
justifications.fit: shared_store_seal_roots at reckon/_worker_fence.py:1143 mirrors the sibling worker_scratch_seal_root at :1110 and the naming checks over the two changed files return no banned label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_worker_fence.py:1273-1275 adds both stores to protected and :1300 skips re-binding each store root, so only declared paths beneath them are granted writable.
justifications.reuse: shared_store_seal_roots at reckon/_worker_fence.py:1143 extends the seal already used at :1265, the sibling of worker_scratch_seal_root at :1110, and a search over reckon/ found no other owner of a delivery-store seal.
justifications.scope_discipline: the net diff at reckon/_worker_fence.py and tests/test_a_worker_cannot_remove_another_runs_reports.py is entirely within the declared write paths, and commit 1's reckon/_backends.py edit does not survive to head.
